name: AAGB
recent: AirAsia Group Berhad 近期与 Malaysia Airports (MAHB) 就约 RM500 million 的欠款进行偿还协商，同时管理层提出 2027 年机队恢复、集资和削减成本的计划。最新财报显示季度营收环比下降 14.5%，净亏损扩大至 RM527 million。
notable: 公司与 Malaysia Airports (MAHB) 就约 RM500 million 欠款进行偿还计划协商。
管理层提出 2027 年重置计划，包括机队恢复、集资和进一步削减成本。
最新季度营收环比下降 14.5%，净亏损 RM527 million。
risks: 公司拖欠 Malaysia Airports 约 RM500 million，偿还方案仍在讨论中。
最新季度净亏损扩大至 RM527 million，净利率为 -10.4%。
执行董事 Datuk Kamarudin bin Meranun 在闭市期前表示有意交易公司证券。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM5,085.58 million，环比下降 14.5%，同比增长 669.6%；净亏损 RM527.16 million，净利率 -10.4%，上年同期净利率为 -2.6%。

recent_en: AirAsia Group Berhad is in repayment talks with Malaysia Airports (MAHB) over about RM500 million in debt, while management outlined a 2027 plan covering fleet recovery, capital raising and cost cuts. The latest quarterly results show revenue down 14.5% QoQ and net loss widening to RM527 million.
notable_en: The company is in repayment talks with Malaysia Airports (MAHB) over about RM500 million in debt.
Management outlined a 2027 reset plan covering fleet recovery, capital raising and further cost cuts.
Latest quarterly revenue fell 14.5% QoQ with a net loss of RM527 million.
risks_en: The company owes Malaysia Airports about RM500 million, with a repayment plan still under discussion.
Latest quarterly net loss widened to RM527 million, with a net margin of -10.4%.
Executive Director Datuk Kamarudin bin Meranun indicated intention to deal in company securities ahead of the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM5,085.58 million, down 14.5% QoQ but up 669.6% YoY; net loss was RM527.16 million with a net margin of -10.4%, versus -2.6% a year earlier.
